category: Ukrainian file host / online cinema (servers seized 2016)

free_tier.stated: Closed. 'Департамент киберполиции Национальной полиции Украины 15 ноября [2016] изъял сервера одного из крупнейших в Украине онлайн-кинотеатров fs.to. Ресурс прекратил работу по основному адресу.'

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the service is closed

retention.stated: not applicable: the servers were seized

interface_detail: None at the main address. A VK page claiming to be official announced a move to a new domain, according to the same report; no working replacement was verified.
chaining: Nothing to chain. Like EX.UA it explains why the Ukrainian market has no domestic large host and why the debrid Ukrainian record is a seedbox (seedbox-org-ua) rather than a host.

limits.value: servers seized 2016-11-15; service stopped at the main address

limits_note: The article names a claimed relocation ('Киберполиция изъяла сервера только на территории Украины') posted on a VK page; the claim is unverified and no live successor was found.
binding_note: Nothing is served; the closure is the fact.

identity_cost.detail: not applicable: no account can be created
